scope_limits: Finite authored PDFs; no OCR, knowledge extraction or science score.
Writer controlled transition faults use deterministic test bytes; real PDF persistence is separately proven by CLI.
No arbitrary power failure, automatic recovery, operating-system sandbox or production Vault claim.
No new desktop installation, cross-platform matrix, 1000-page performance or 24-hour test.
Path association uses the selected spelling; Windows equivalent spelling changes were not separately accepted.
